differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia (MCV 44.6 fL) with low hemoglobin in a young adult, common with poor nutrition and chronic blood loss.

differential.name: Beta‑thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Very low MCV in a Black individual; RBC count is relatively preserved, suggesting a hemoglobinopathy rather than true iron deficiency.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease/inflammation
differential.rationale: Chronic pain, stress, possible low‑grade inflammation and borderline elevated creatinine can suppress erythropoiesis.

differential.name: Chronic kidney disease (stage 3)
differential.rationale: Elevated creatinine (1.3 mg/dL) for age/possible female sex, obesity and pre‑diabetes raise risk; CKD can cause anemia.

differential.name: Sickle cell trait/disease
differential.rationale: Black ethnicity and mild anemia; however hemoglobin is near normal and no hemolysis markers, making it less likely.
